projects.title: Power BI Business Performance Dashboard
projects.tagline: Interactive Executive Dashboard & Sales KPI Analytics
projects.problemStatement: Organizations often struggle to uncover cross-regional sales trends and revenue bottlenecks from fragmented transactional sheets.
projects.description: Engineered an interactive multi-page Power BI dashboard connecting relational sales data. Modeled KPIs including total revenue, gross margins, regional distribution, and month-over-month growth using custom DAX calculations and dynamic filters.

projects.title: Power BI Operational Metrics & KPI Tracker
projects.problemStatement: Operational teams require clear visual indicators to detect delays, monitor volume throughput, and track customer fulfillment metrics in real time.
projects.description: Designed a comprehensive Power BI reporting suite focused on operational throughput, category-wise demand distribution, and fulfillment efficiency. Features interactive slicers, drill-through cards, and automated color-coded alert thresholds.

projects.title: Titanic Dataset Exploratory Data Analysis
projects.problemStatement: Understanding historical survival patterns requires systematic data cleaning, handling missing ages and embarked ports, and evaluating multi-factor demographic correlations.
projects.description: Conducted a rigorous Python exploratory data analysis (EDA) on the classic Titanic dataset as part of the Yuva Virtual Data Science Apprenticeship. Analyzed passenger demographics, ticket class disparities, fare distributions, and family size survival correlation using Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn heatmaps.

projects.title: Supervised Machine Learning Model Exploration
projects.problemStatement: Evaluating classification boundaries and comparing baseline models requires proper feature normalization, encoding, and balanced evaluation metrics.
projects.description: Built a structured machine learning pipeline in Python to preprocess tabular data, handle categorical encodings, train baseline classification models, and benchmark evaluation metrics including precision, recall, and ROC-AUC score.

projects.title: AI Interview Coach Application
projects.tagline: Interactive Practice Assistant for Technical & Behavioral Interviews
projects.problemStatement: Students preparing for tech and data science placements often lack structured, on-demand interview questioning and targeted feedback.
projects.description: An AI-assisted interview preparation prototype created to help aspiring candidates practice technical concepts, data science questions, and behavioral responses with immediate prompt-guided structuring.

learningJourney.summary: Constructing robust end-to-end preprocessing pipelines combining imputation, numerical scalers, categorical encoders, and cross-validation.
keyConcepts: Target leakage prevention via Pipeline encapsulation

faq.question: What is Shaik Ali Ahammad’s primary academic background and career aspiration?
faq.answer: Shaik Ali Ahammad is an undergraduate student pursuing a B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Muthayammal Engineering College, Rasipuram (Batch of 2028). His career goal is to become a skilled Data Scientist and secure an opportunity at a leading technology company.

faq.question: What core technical stack and analytical tools does Shaik utilize?
faq.answer: His core skillset includes Python for data science and scripting, SQL for database querying and aggregation, MongoDB for NoSQL document modeling, Microsoft Power BI for executive dashboard building and DAX analytics, and Microsoft Excel for spreadsheet manipulation and pivot analysis.

faq.question: What practical experience was completed during the Yuva Apprenticeship?
faq.answer: As a Yuva Virtual Data Science with Python Apprentice, Shaik focused on data exploration and analytical techniques, culminating in a thorough exploratory data analysis project on the Titanic dataset examining passenger survival demographics and multi-variable correlations.

faq.question: What types of Power BI dashboards have been built?
faq.answer: Shaik has developed two distinct Power BI dashboard projects: an executive sales & performance analytics dashboard featuring star schema modeling and custom DAX measures, and an operational metrics tracker providing visibility into process volumes and fulfillment thresholds.
